title: One to Five, and the Words English Already Says
label: ch:fa-count-five
canDo: I can say, hear and recognise the Persian numbers one to five, write the one of them made only of letters I have been taught, and name the English cousin of each.

payoff.summary: Five numbers, five Indo-European roots and five everyday English cousins — retrieved shuffled rather than recited, with the one writable form written.
